sentences.en: She had many awards, notably a Nobel Prize.
sentences.zh: 1. 她获得了许多奖项，尤其值得一提的是诺贝尔奖。

sentences.en: I like the weather notably when there are no clouds in the sky.
sentences.zh: 2. 我喜欢天气晴朗的时候，尤其是在天空没有云彩时。

sentences.en: Life expectancy has been improving, most notably among the young and the poor.
sentences.zh: 3. 人均寿命有所提高，尤其是年轻人和穷人的寿命有了显著提升。

phrases.zh: 1. 尤其是, 最值得注意的是
